test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 9 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, ‘SCALE’ is written as ‘UACJG’ and ‘LIGHT’ is written as ‘NGIFV’. How will ‘LIMIT’ be written in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

‘SCALE’ is written as ‘UACJG’ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f5de36e1734be3542ee60f361282d6ba7a1c8060e9fe20880f2706b9221c55ef.png] 

 

‘LIGHT’ is written as ‘NGIFV’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8bda092e741e88b7788f22a82440a53ac5f7efc68874ec44246aebda39abea40.png] 

Similarly, ‘LIMIT’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c21542a7cb2f87fba91c062777e9c319853bc7e618174f520c426fd069ab9bee.png] 

Hence,** 'option 4'** is the correct answer.
